current_target: frozen QEMU cortex-a57 (baseline Armv8, no LSE)
conclusion: The common +lse flag is not adopted: emitted LSE instructions cannot execute on the frozen functional target cortex-a57. Staged IR only uses supported add/or/and, so unsupported hypothetical XOR/exchange/CAS must not be reported as a current catalog regression. Static asymmetry with the Spark kernel LSE path is real, but hot-path contribution and performance cause are not measured. No framework CPU override, helper dispatch or weakened atomic ordering introduced.
